fields.description: What this society calls this membership type: Life Member, Youth, Corporate. Display only; nothing in the engine reads it to decide anything.
fields.label: Membership Type

fields.description: The stable business key, and the docname. A membership points at its type by this key, so relabelling the type never rewrites history or breaks a report.
fields.label: Type Key

fields.description: An inactive type keeps its existing memberships but refuses new ones, so retiring a type does not orphan the people on it.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Who this type is for, in the society's own words.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: What this membership costs. Zero means no fee is collected, and a zero-fee type never initiates a payment at all.
fields.label: Fee

fields.description: The currency of the fee. Empty falls back to the society's configured currency from National Society Settings; no currency is ever assumed in code.
fields.label: Fee Currency

fields.description: A membership of this type never expires. It activates with a start date and no end date, so the daily expiry sweep never touches it and it is never renewable. A lifetime type carries no duration; any value here is cleared on save.
fields.label: Is Lifetime

fields.description: How long a membership of this type stays valid, in days. Counted from activation, so the clock starts when the member actually becomes one. A lifetime type is not asked for one.
fields.label: Duration (Days)

fields.description: MEM-02. How a membership of this type becomes active. routed: it goes through the VMMS approval engine and a resolved human approves it. auto_on_payment: it activates the moment payment is confirmed, with no approver. This field selects the path: no source file branches on a membership type's name to decide it.
fields.label: Approval Mode

fields.description: Why this type approves the way it does. Notes for the next administrator; never read by code.
fields.label: Approval Note

fields.description: Which VMMS Template renders this type's membership certificate. Configuration, not a constant: pointing it at a different template changes every certificate this type issues, with no code change.
fields.label: Certificate Template

fields.description: What a member of this type is entitled to.
fields.label: Benefits
